thresholds.famine_rule: Both population-share thresholds; engine HasFamine is authoritative

limitations: Read-only screening; no automatic runtime patch or historical census validation.
Static employment uses 25/30/35% workforce scenarios, not all inhabitants.
Unspecified PM groups use an envelope; upper bound may include unavailable technologies. No guaranteed hiring or food security.
Duplicate create_building declarations use minimum-to-sum level envelope; native save resolves actual levels.
Owner land is estimated from habitable provinces, with effective prime-land weighting and allocation rounding uncertainty; native arable_land overrides when available.
Food-security POP caches at initial pause may contradict engine famine_manager; native crisis flags and manually observed UI are separate authoritative observations.
Construction, future urban centers, ownership jobs and modifiers can alter static totals.
Full staffing is not proof of inputs, production, wages, market access or qualification.
